description: The file defines function prototypes for adding and deleting device objects in a device management context. It includes licensing information and include guards, and declares two external functions related to device object management.

methods.name: DM_ENG_Device_AddDeleteObject_Add
methods.description: Function to add a device object, taking environment, object name, instance number pointer, and status pointer as parameters.

methods.name: DM_ENG_Device_AddDeleteObject_Delete
methods.description: Function to delete a device object, taking environment, object name, and status pointer as parameters.
